verdict.rationale: Marqeta's docs are available in machine-readable .md format per-page (e.g., cards.md, introduction.md), which is agent-friendly, but there is no llms.txt index file and probes for llms.txt and a consolidated docs.md both return 404. Missing for 10: a dedicated llms.txt manifest, a single agent-oriented entry point, and confirmation that individual .md pages are discoverable/crawlable without prior knowledge of URLs.
